# coralogix_view_folder (Resource)

Coralogix View Folder. Folders group saved views in the Explore screen. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/monitoring-and-insights/explore-screen/custom-views/.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    coralogix = {
      version = "~> 3.0"
      source  = "coralogix/coralogix"
    }
  }
}

provider "coralogix" {
  #api_key = "<add your api key here or add env variable CORALOGIX_API_KEY>"
  #env = "<add the environment you want to work at or add env variable CORALOGIX_ENV>"
}

resource "coralogix_view_folder" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the view folder. Between 1 and 100 characters - the backend silently truncates a longer name, so the provider rejects it instead. Folder names must currently be unique within the team.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the view folder, assigned by Coralogix. Stays the same when the folder is renamed.
